import copy
from boltons.typeutils import make_sentinel, issubclass, get_all_subclasses, classproperty
def test_sentinel():
    s = make_sentinel('missing')
    assert not s
    assert copy.copy(s) is s
    assert copy.deepcopy(s) is s
    assert s is not make_sentinel('missing')
def test_types():
    class A: pass
    class B(A): pass
    class C(B): pass
    assert issubclass(B, A)
    assert not issubclass('bad', A)
    assert get_all_subclasses(A) == [B, C]
def test_classproperty():
    class Example:
        @classproperty
        def value(cls): return cls.__name__
    assert Example.value == 'Example'
    assert Example().value == 'Example'
